title: Thermodynamic Value of XOR-Game-Induced Side Information in a Szilard Engine
summary: In this work, we study the reversible work value of a binary side-information channel supplied to a Szilard engine. The working system is a classical thermal bit, while the feedback controller receives only a binary record correlated with its physical state. We show that a fixed average prediction accuracy does not determine a unique thermodynamic value, because different binary channels with the same accuracy can carry different amounts of mutual information. We derive the exact minimum and maximum reversible Szilard work compatible with a given prediction accuracy. The minimum is attained…
